探尋高質量發展新路徑，中央明確「著力               pathways for high-quality development through deep adjustments,
穩定房地產」，推動行業向發展新模式平               with the central government’s clear directive to “focus on stabilizing
穩過渡。作為地產行業邁向專業化的重                the real estate market”, which drove the industry toward a smooth
要一環，代建儘管同樣面臨市場縮緊、                transition to a new development model. As a crucial step toward the
業績承壓的考驗，但憑藉輕資產、高效                professionalization of the real estate industry, our project management
率、低風險的商業模式，展現出強大的                has demonstrated remarkable resilience and growth potential
發展韌性與成長潛質。在此背景下，作                attributable to our asset-light, high-efficiency and low-risk business
為行業領頭羊的綠城管理，捕捉業務機                model despite market contraction and performance pressures. Against
遇、深化組織改革、加強能力建設、推                this background, as an industry leader, Greentown Management has
動模式創新，以不斷鞏固的核心競爭力                seized business opportunities, deepened organizational reforms,
與穩健紮實的經營業績，回應利益相關                strengthened capability building, and driven model innovation. We have
方與社會關切，引領行業向高質量發展。               continuously consolidated core competitiveness with robust operating
                                 results to address stakeholders and societal concerns, leading the
                                 industry toward high-quality development.

股息政策                          DIVIDEND POLICY
本公司的未來股息宣派將由董事全權酌             The future declarations of dividends of the Company will be at the
情決定。宣派及派付的任何股息金額將             absolute discretion of the Directors. Any amount of dividends declared
取決於本公司的未來營運及盈利、資本             and paid will depend on the Company’s future operations and earnings,

 益表、綜合權益變動表及綜合現金流量                              comprehensive income, the consolidated statement of changes in

 會計政策資料。                                        ended, and notes to the consolidated financial statements, including
